name: Zipz (Garden City, UT) Hot Crinkle-Cut French Fries or Tater Gems
whyItWorks: Crinkle-cut russet fries are soft and fluffy on the inside with a crisp exterior. A classic lake side dish tolerated well in stable remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order regular crinkle-cut fries or tater gems with light salt; dip in ketchup or plain mayo.
watchOuts: Frying oil can aggravate intestinal motility during acute flareups
